name: Mahou Shoujo Marin ~Chijoku no Zenra Dogeza~
original_name: 魔法少女マリン 〜恥辱の全裸土下座〜
source:
She's cute and looks the part, 
but Magical Girl Marin is totally powerless. 
Every battle is a disaster! She just loses! 
That means instant r*pe. Virginity? Pffttt. 

Meet the losingest magical girl since Elle. 
Pigbeasts to tentacles to townspeople 
paint a coat of shame on the new cum-soaked "make shojo". 

But Marin is not disheartened. 
It's just so many shed tears of violent indulgence. 
Today's another glorious day... to fail... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165096.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她很可爱，看起来也很适合这个角色 
但魔法少女玛琳却完全无能为力。
每一场战斗都是一场灾难！她只是输了！
这意味着即时恢复。童贞？噗。

来认识一下《Elle》以来最失败的魔法少女吧。
从猪兽到触手再到城镇居民 
在新的精液浸泡的“make shojo”上涂上一层羞耻的外衣。

但马林并没有灰心。
这只是太多人因暴力放纵而流下的眼泪。
今天又是光荣的一天……失败了…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165096.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
